title: Probe and exploit evidence is correlated without declaring character guilt
summary: Bouncer can correlate route enumeration, injection candidates, malformed protocol behavior, privilege-boundary probes and related signals across entry surfaces. It records candidate/probabilistic findings rather than declaring an origin or person inherently malicious.
invariants: Probe observations retain source/provenance and do not become moral labels.
Cross-surface correlation may strengthen an attack-campaign finding, but one strange request does not poison every ability.
Probe interpretation thresholds are fixed/versioned policy artifacts.

provenance.claim: README and executable probe tests cover deterministic probe analysis and exploit scoping.
